text:
anna (partnerships): Heads-up — coordinating the joint launch with LangChain + VectorGrid (HW partner) next month. Need marketplace SKU, SI enablement plan, and a short blackout window for the co-announcement.

sam (product): +1. Do we have final perf numbers on the quantized adapter for LangChain v1.5? marketplace listing will need TPS/latency bullets.

wei (eng-ml): We finished perf runs on the GA-replicas last night. 99th p50 token latency at 512 context on VectorGrid A40-optim is ~85ms with our batching profile. I can paste the run command if helpful: 
```
run_bench --model redwood-lite-q4_0 --hw vectorgrid-a40 --batch 8 --ctx 512 --trace
```

marie (bd): Great — buyers will want the instance SKU name + cost delta vs standard. Can someone surface COGS delta for Dedicated vs hosted? Also need a one-paragraph partner quote from VectorGrid.

alex (solutions): I can draft the SI enablement playbook sections: install checklist, example configs for LangChain adapters, and a short troubleshooting runbook. Will ping SI leads for training timeslots.

anna (partnerships): Timeline check — marketing wants marketplace draft by EOW (1761300000). Tech doc + playbook by next Tue. Blackout window proposed: 48h starting at release deploy. Thoughts? :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

wei (eng-ml): 48h looks ok as long as we gate the model-promote step behind canary telemetry. I'll add a health-check hook that fails open to fallback-small if error rate spikes.

sam (product): For marketplace SKU copy, one-liner: "Redwood Inference — LangChain Adapter (VectorGrid-optimized) — low-latency, GPU-accelerated inference". Need confirmation on supported LangChain versions and LlamaIndex mapping.

alex (solutions): Supported LangChain: 1.4–1.6. LlamaIndex mapping: we surface index->chunk mapping and provide a schema sample. I'll attach sample `index_schema.json` in the docs PR.

marie (bd): Also confirm legal/embargo timing with VectorGrid — they asked for a 24h partner preview before public. Can we align?

anna (partnerships): Let's do partner preview 24h before public, then 48h blackout after deploy. That means internal freeze from 1761290000 to 1761310000-ish. I'll coordinate calendars.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `marketplace/llm-adapter/vectorgrid-v1` — scheduled 1761307200.

wei (eng-ml): Noted. I'll run the final smoke bench at T-2h and post results here.

sam (product): Action items: 1) wei — final perf artifact + commands. 2) alex — SI playbook + sample config. 3) marie — partner quote + embargo confirmation. 4) anna — orchestrate calendars + marketplace draft. I'll sync on Thursday live 10am PT.

anna (partnerships): Thanks — tagging the calendar invite now. :thumbsup:

alex (solutions): Quick note — add a step in the playbook to opt into "carbon-optimized" GPU SKU since VectorGrid requested sustainability callout.

marie (bd): Love that — marketing will include a small sustainability blurb in the marketplace bullets.

wei (eng-ml): Final bench posted: `p50 85ms / p99 210ms / tokens/sec 620` — I'll upload the raw traces to the shared run bucket after the smoke run.

anna (partnerships): Perfect. Closing thread for now — please post any blockers. We will resume with the dry-run report after the smoke bench.
